card.name: Small words after verbs like be, study, turn
card.fires_on: Short linking words (in, at, of) or verbs like turned and started that follow a verb and come before a noun of state or place, such as business, school, use, power or position. Mostly in general web prose about history and biography.

modes.label: Preposition after verb
modes.description: in, at or of right after a verb, before a state or place noun.
modes.example: the foundry has been<< in>> business since 1570 producing

modes.label: Turned/started verbs
modes.description: A verb of change or beginning after a subject, before an object or infinitive.
modes.example: Mill<< started>> to learn Greek at three and at eight
